text_block_list.text:
Special Week managed to achieve splendid 
results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Looking around the trainer's office like 
this really brings back a lot of memories, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We've talked about so much... and worked 
so hard together, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once I get back to the dorm, I'm going to 
write a letter to Mom. About my training, 
about the races—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"And then... about the precious person who 
watched over me closer than anyone else. 
...I'll write a lot about them."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It might turn out a little long, but... 
please read it all the way to the end, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'll have to stay up late 
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. Thank you so very much 
for these past three years!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And also— I'll be counting on you from now 
on as well!
